dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Progressive narrowing from the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle, resulting in a triangular 2D profile at the rear third.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Subtle irregular curvature on the left lateral margin (image left) compared to the more uniform taper of the right margin.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to off-white across the dorsal plane; lacks the pure white intensity of a fully mature adult.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Sparse distribution of small, low-contrast light patches across the mid-dorsal area and darker grey shading around the neck region.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; no sharp demarcations between varying shades of grey and white pigment.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Several small, high-reflectance points on the dorsal surface, likely representing water droplets or minor epidermal pitting.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Distinct linear dorsal ridge starting mid-back and extending to the peduncle, creating a visible longitudinal shadow.

other_distinctive_markers: Dark, circular blowhole aperture clearly visible at the anterior dorsal end.
